punchline: Bezos kept an empty chair for the customer, and when he dialed his own support line on speaker, the wait ran far past what his executive had reported.
thirty_sec: At Amazon, a forwarded customer complaint with nothing but a question mark from Bezos sent a team scrambling. In one meeting he asked his head of customer service about hold times and heard well under a minute. So he put his speakerphone on the conference table and dialed the 800 number while thirty executives listened. Brad Stone says it took four and a half minutes for an agent to answer.
